plan: A support mage who empowers one of her spells with her ultimate to poke or protect.
aSurveiller: Her W (Focused Resolve). She tethers to you and roots you if you don't break the tether: move away from her quickly.
contrer: Move away when she tethers to you (W): otherwise you get rooted.
Stay behind your minions: her Q explodes on the first one hit.
Engage her once her R is used: her spells are weaker.
forces: Shields and speed for her allies.
Her R empowers a spell every time.
faiblesses: Low damage in the late game.

sorts.P: Her spells lower the cooldown of her R.
sorts.W: Tethers to an enemy and roots them if the tether holds.
sorts.E: Shield and speed for an ally.

momentFort: Strong in the early game, in her lane.
